# Amira Medical Staffing

> Healthcare recruitment and staffing solutions connecting medical professionals with hospitals, nursing facilities, and healthcare organizations.

Amira Medical Staffing is a staffing agency based in Garden City, Michigan specializing in temporary and direct-hire placement services for healthcare facilities. The company provides recruitment solutions for hospitals, nursing facilities, and other healthcare organizations seeking qualified medical professionals.
